title: The Designer Theme Kit's 231 design-system files are on file, each claimed by a rule, with every gap listed
detail: Intake of the matured Designer design system (limewash + daylight). The kit extends the existing designer theme in place (same palette, Cormorant and Jost); Alli Rae's saved site keeps resolving to it and must render identically. docs/design-systems/designer holds the rules, inventory with hashes, tokens, copy and a baseline of known gaps (194 token values, 22 missing targets, 391 copy sentences) which the build passes can only shrink. The 14 sample photographs ship byte for byte under public/sites/designer/photos. scripts/design-system.test.ts reads the Designer token block. Ledger block LIVE-1740..1769 is reserved for this lane.

verify.evidence: All 231 files are claimed; the baseline lists the rest.
